# Kill policy
Players are entitled to their own agency, so if players want to go out of their way to be belligerent, they can be killed, which is known as "escalation", escalation is simple, if someone steals a mag or something thats not really important to you, its result should (can be more) be a fistfight, maybe even an invitation to "The Pit" to have it on live TV or alternatively just use disabler weapons and stun them long enough to restrain them and get your stuff back, if then the person, mid-fistfight, decides to pull out a deadly weapon capable of dealing serious physical damage, and attempts to use this weapon against another person, this allows you to pull your own weapon, even a gun, to deal with this situation, if they realize this, and instead pull out an explosive, you can pull out your own explosive, or even call a whole gang to gang up on this clearly deranged individual, this goes on until maxcaps, which are just really cheap nukes: these are to be handled like antags, if you wish to maxcap make sure to declare these 3 beforehand: where, why, when, and give a 20 second grace period for everyone to evacuate, note that this is THE escalation, so any measures taken to avoid a maxcap ARE valid, even maxcapping back.
[bold]TLDR: if you are under threat of grave bodily damage, you can use another threat of grave bodily damage to fight back against an active threat, if threat is negligible, deal with it in a relaxed manner. Don't kill someone for taking a bag of chips from you... though it could escalate from a fist fight to a gun-fight.[/bold]
